header.buildingModern: Building modern web and mobile applications with cutting-edge technologies

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a passionate fullstack developer with expertise in building modern web and mobile applications. With a strong foundation in Next.js, React, and TypeScript, I create scalable, performant, and user-friendly applications.
about.paragraph2: My experience spans across the entire development stack, from designing intuitive user interfaces to implementing robust backend systems and database architectures. I'm particularly skilled in building complex applications with sophisticated state management and synchronization systems.
about.paragraph3: I'm always eager to take on challenging projects that push the boundaries of what's possible with modern web technologies.

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.description: SplitWallet is a sophisticated expense-sharing application designed to help users track, manage, and split expenses within groups. The app allows users to create wallets (expense groups), add expenses, track balances, generate reports, and settle debts efficiently.

technical.title: Technical Highlights
technical.item1: Built as a monorepo using Next.js, tRPC, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle ORM
technical.item2: Implemented a sophisticated state synchronization system for offline functionality
technical.item3: Integrated AI-powered receipt scanning using Gemini 2.5 Pro
technical.item4: Developed a smart debt minimization algorithm with multiple reimbursement modes
technical.item5: Created a comprehensive design system with light and dark mode support

features.title: Key Features
features.item1: Expense management with custom distribution among users
features.item2: Group management with multiple wallets and hierarchical organization
features.item3: Real-time updates and offline support with data synchronization
features.item4: Multiple language support and currency conversion
features.item5: Premium features with Stripe subscription integration
